tvShow.name: Tan cerca de ti, nace el amor
tvShow.originalName: Tan cerca de ti, nace el amor
tvShow.overview: After her newborn daughter is taken from her and given up for adoption, journalist Verónica Arellano spends years searching for her. When tragedy leaves the girl's adoptive family shattered, Verónica assumes a new identity to stay close to her daughter, setting in motion a story of love, family, and long-buried secrets.
